basis: The first qualifying disclosure was SEACOR Marine’s Q1 2025 earnings release. Its consolidated income statement reports operating revenues of $55,499,000 for the three months ended March 31, 2025 and $62,770,000 for the same quarter of 2024. The 95% threshold was $59,631,500. Reported revenue was $4,132,500 below it, down 11.6% year over year. The statement presents vessel-disposition gains separately from operating revenues.

coverage.detail: October 30, 2024, Q3 earnings release. The CEO discussed more than $360 million of contracted backlog including options and inquiries for 2025–2026 liftboat work. Neither figure established a Q1 2025 consolidated revenue ceiling.

December 2, 2024, investor presentation. Slide 5 grouped backlog by Q4 2024, full-year 2025 and 2026 onward. It covered charters of at least 30 days, included options and excluded the anchor-handling vessel class. It supplied no Q1 2025 total revenue forecast.

December 2 transaction release. Management disclosed $22.5 million of vessel-sale proceeds and an exit from the anchor-handling vessel class effective January 2025. It did not quantify the effect on Q1 consolidated operating revenues.

February 26, 2025, preceding quarterly earnings release. The $69.8 million revenue figure and 4.5% year-over-year decline applied to Q4 2024. The CEO described subdued demand in the North Sea and Mexico and healthy inquiries in most other international markets, without giving a numeric Q1 2025 revenue outlook.

February 28 investor update. Slide 9 reported $368 million in multiyear charter backlog including options. The market outlook discussed industry demand and offshore capital spending. Neither established an upper bound on SEACOR Marine’s Q1 revenue.
April 4, after quarter end. The release announced a roughly $12.9 million securities repurchase. The CEO said a vessel sale helped fund it. The release gave no preliminary Q1 operating revenues.

The issuer’s presentation archive lists February 2025 between December 2024 and September 2025. Searches outside EDGAR for intervening preliminary results, updated guidance, public calls and dated management remarks identified no earlier qualifying disclosure.
April 30 issuer release. The consolidated income statement gives the exact comparative figures in thousands of dollars. The issuer also explicitly reports an 11.6% year-over-year revenue decline.

publication_date_evidence: SEACOR Marine’s investor-relations page timestamps the Q1 results release April 30, 2025 at 4:27 PM EDT. The matching SEC Exhibit 99.1 is dated April 30, 2025 and marked for immediate release.
